title: Practice 1: One direction, or round and about

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **летать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

**летать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
